title: Install VOOL: a guide for installers
description: How to buy, install and commission VOOL chargers and load management, the limits to know before you quote, and how to get listed.

sections.title: Fewer cables, a smaller main fuse, faster jobs
sections.lead: VOOL lets you put many chargers on the connection the building already has. Here is how to buy, install and commission it.
sections.alt: VOOL Charger opened: casing, charge controller and front panel

items.title: No grid upgrade to quote
items.text: The LMC measures the building load and shares the spare capacity. One site runs 45 chargers on a 125 A connection.

items.title: Three parts, in this order
items.text: Mount the casing and connect the cables. Click in the charge controller. Attach the front panel.

items.title: Prepare now, finish later
items.text: Install the casings and cabling for every space. Add the controller when the owner orders charging.

items.title: Phases balance themselves
items.text: Chargers switch single-phase cars to the least loaded phase.

items.title: Works offline
items.text: Load management runs locally between the LMC and the chargers.

items.title: You keep remote access
items.text: After handover you can still see the sites you set up, so most questions are answered without a visit.

items.title: Buy
items.text: From a wholesaler in your country, or ask us who stocks VOOL near you.

items.title: Install
items.text: Follow the installation guide. Chargers connect to the LMC over CAN in a daisy chain, or over the local network.

items.title: Commission
items.text: Set up the LMC and chargers in the VOOL App over Bluetooth: fuse sizes, phase order, network.

items.title: Hand over
items.text: Transfer the site to the owner in the app. They add users and prices in the VOOL Portal.

items.a: TN systems. On IT systems, common in parts of Norway, charging works but load management does not.

Yes. Connect the LMC and the chargers with the same phase order (L1 to L1 and so on), because chargers switch phases based on the free capacity the LMC measures. The order can be corrected in the app afterwards.

items.q: Can I daisy-chain Ethernet through the charger?
items.a: No. Both ports support CAN daisy-chaining, but only one port can be used for Ethernet.

items.q: The LMC has a SIM. Is it online out of the box?
items.a: No. Mobile data is switched on in the VOOL App over Bluetooth during commissioning.

items.q: The charger does not detect the car after installation.
items.a: Check that the CP connector on the small cover of the orange charge controller is fully seated. It is the most common cause.

items.q: Is the back cable channel with entry from below a correct installation?
items.a: Yes. Water and snow do not enter through the vent openings.

items.q: What about chargers installed from 1 January 2027?
items.a: They must support ISO 15118-20. Order the new VOOL Charger, available from mid-December 2026.
